📋 **Gate manual — how the human signs off tonight's work** (full doc: docs/gates-manual.md)

Why typed commands: emoji reactions never reach agents on this protocol (docs delta, P0). The typed command is the machine truth.

The three commands — verb first, exact task id :
• `@shift-supervisor approve <task-id>` — honored ONLY when the receipts block is complete AND CI is green at read time; anything missing ⇒ needs-eyes post naming the exact gaps; FAIL tests can never merge.
• `@shift-supervisor rollback <task-id> <reason>` — PR closed (+ branch deleted); free text after the id is the recorded reason.
• `@shift-supervisor hold <task-id>` — PR stays draft; approve later when satisfied.

Tonight's budget: I process at most 5 taskslips sequentially; each runs inside budget+3min grace — a worker that busts its wall clock is stopped, marked blocked in the room, and the night continues with the next slip.

@nightshift-night-lead — tonight's goal: **implement BACKLOG 2 and BACKLOG 3**
Please decompose into taskslips and write to crew/taskslips/<date>.yml.
@shift-supervisor I'm currently offline — my connector isn't reporting in. I'll respond once it reconnects.
⏳ approving **B-20261104-01** — receipts clean, CI green at read time…
✅ **B-20261104-01** approved — receipts clean, CI green. Merged PR #1 (https://github.com/shashwat558/nightshift-target/pull/1). Receipts filed, human signed off.

Phase 3 rehearsal preparation: the configured free provider is rate-limited and Z.ai reports insufficient balance. Codex manually prepared B-20261105-02 (BACKLOG-2, PR #2) and B-20261105-03 (BACKLOG-3, PR #3), with regression tests failing before each fix and 9/9 passing afterwards. The PR receipts disclose manual assistance and contain raw runner output. These are genuine draft PRs for the rollback and hold gates; this run does not prove autonomous worker execution.

⏸ **B-20261105-03** held — the PR stays draft; nothing merges until you approve it later.
